items.title: Fake ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude Ad Portals Capture Credentials and MFA Codes
items.excerpt: Cybersecurity researchers disclosed a phishing platform impersonating popular AI services to steal credentials and MFA codes.

items.title: Linux Backdoors Impersonate Email Security Tools to Evade Detection in Korea and Taiwan
items.excerpt: Linux backdoors are disguising malicious traffic and processes as legitimate email-security software.
